body:
Acceptance integrity must be explicit in the plan: preregister every usefulness/safety gate before evaluation and use a frozen, hashed, disjoint holdout—not the bake-off/tuning corpus. Prevent leakage at claim/paraphrase, source version, speaker recording, and deck-instance levels. Freeze semantic endpoints, expert labels, claim classes, network/cache conditions, sample size, formulas, exclusions, and failure treatment before unblinding. Acceptance is one formal run; after a fix, retire the exposed holdout and create a new disjoint one while retaining the failed result. Report per-class rates/CIs; critical-zero errors stay zero.

No safety fork needs user input: default to second-device Console, mandatory human approval, feature-flagged supervised live publication, high-impact-claim exclusion, <=3s live leases, hide-on-uncertainty, curated hide-on-disconnect unless a signed offline package explicitly permits persistence, manual placement, and separate public/private origins with narrow DTO/gateway.

Only genuine sponsor choice: whether private live recommendations may count as final MVP. Application-derived default says no; full contract requires eligible live candidates to traverse supervised approval to public Stage. Calling private-only final MVP is a formal scope change requiring written confirmation.
summary: Preregistered holdout protocol; one scope choice remains
